data.title: Solana Confirms a Transaction in 200 Milliseconds and Bitcoin Takes 10 Minutes. Does Speed Make a Coin Worth More?
data.description: Solana just became 3,000 times faster than Bitcoin at producing blocks, yet its coin lost nearly 8% of its value the same week. The relationship between blockchain speed and price turns out to be far more complicated than it looks.
